name: image-resizer
description: Secure, high-performance image resizing and processing SPA (React + Express + sharp).

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client
scripts.test: npm run test -w server && npm run test -w client
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run build
